title: Felix and the Letter
author: Wren Zhou
blurb: Oscar Sterling, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
